module: storage URL rewriting and file transport

findings.title: Streaming links are not rewritten when a delta splits the URI scheme
findings.scenario: In public URL mode an answer delta ends with resou, local:/ or a partial storage:// prefix in a normal link, HTML href or plain reference. The prefix is emitted before it is recognized; following deltas retain an unfetchable URI or produce storage://backend/https://..., while the same completed answer rewrites correctly.
findings.reproduction: Every two-delta boundary for ten supported reference forms and four renderings; 186 failing subcases on original implementation.
findings.fix: Hold a bounded trailing prefix of a known scheme until the next delta resolves it; existing holdback size and UTF-8 boundaries stay in force.

invariants_checked: Handle/public selection, forced embed handle mode, restricted-key refusal of public links, owner/backend routing and authorization before signing.
Request-local synchronized rewrite memo; shared reference copy behavior and bounded stream buffers.
File transport closes readers, uses safe disposition/nosniff, supports seekable ranges and HEAD, keeps streaming backends unbuffered.
Provider allow-list canonical parsing, defensive copies and unknown-provider rejection.
limitations: Provider URL calls used test doubles; no public deployment or live provider service exercised.
Audited the three library units and their narrow call boundaries, not entire IM/session modules.
No actionable findings identified in filetransport or storageallowlist.
